Revise: the same dramatic, stylized cinematic typography, and this time featuring increased depth of field during the panning transitions.
statement: This sketch creates a cinematic title sequence where text appears to emerge from varying depths in three-dimensional space. Using WEBGL rendering, it positions letters at different Z-coordinates to create perspective depth, with the camera continuously panning through the scene. Each character has its own subtle animation and responds to distance-based opacity changes that give a sense of spatial movement. The rich color palette with glowing text elements against deep black backgrounds creates a polished, dramatic visual effect reminiscent of film openings. The continuous camera motion and dynamic lighting enhance the sense of depth while maintaining a smooth, engaging visual flow across the canvas.
